payload.detail: PARTLY FIXED 2026-09-25 in 3293c1fb8: calculator tiles carry data-calculator-open, and /calculators/search restores focus to the tile in an effect after the ?calculator= removal commits, via restoreFocusUnlessMoved (pinned by tests/calculator-focus-return.dom.test.tsx). STILL OPEN: the /documents/search Filter sheet leaves focus on body though the trigger is still in the DOM. Likely cause (read from code, not browser-verified): document-search-results.tsx mounts ResultFilterSheet only while filterPanelOpen, so on close the Sheet unmounts and ui/sheet.tsx skips its focus restore behind the unmountingRef guard. Passing returnFocusRef alone would therefore not fix it; keep the sheet mounted with open={filterPanelOpen}, or restore focus from the caller. The document-actions sheet restores correctly, so ui/sheet.tsx is sound. WCAG F85 against SC 2.4.3.
